## Summary

Full-Stack Software Engineer who ships products to production and keeps them running.
Four production systems built, deployed and operated, each on its own self-managed VPS:
a university services platform officially adopted by Al Sham Private University's housing
department (EduPal), a marketplace founded from scratch (WeinKorsi), a B2B loyalty platform
where he is technical partner (Lumi Rewards), and a classifieds platform in pre-launch
(OboSyria). Also maintains a legal foundation's bilingual public site, hosted on Railway. Flutter mobile development, Laravel REST backends,
Linux/Nginx operations with monitoring and automated backups, and AI automation with n8n.

Freelance full-stack software engineer since January 2024. At Lumi Coin Syria since
September 2025, now as technical partner owning the technical direction of Lumi Rewards.

## Production systems

### WeinKorsi (وين كورسي)
https://wein-korsi.com/
Android app (v1.2.13, direct APK download): https://wein-korsi.com/android-app
Founder & Sole Developer (product, backend, web, mobile, infrastructure and deployment).
Platform to find courses and institutes in Syria by governorate, area, level and price;
students contact institutes on WhatsApp or reserve a seat. As of November 2026: 150+
users, 15+ institutes and 100+ courses. Contact requires sign-in, so
every enquiry is an attributed lead; institute self-registration with email and WhatsApp
OTP verification, versioned terms acceptance and admin approval; course matching by level,
interests and GPS distance; privacy-first analytics (hashed visitor IDs, aggregated counts
only); append-only admin audit log, role-based staff accounts, Zero Trust protected admin;
Arabic/English with full RTL and dark mode. Scripted deploys with post-deploy health checks;
1,400+ backend, 400+ web and 800+ Flutter tests.
Stack: Laravel API, PostgreSQL, React, Flutter (Android), Cloudflare (CDN, Zero Trust),
Cloudflare R2, VPS.

### Lumi Rewards
https://lumi-rewards.app
Technical Partner & Full-Stack Developer (Lumi Coin Syria), a partner in the business,
not a contractor. Owns the technical direction of this B2B loyalty platform for the Syrian
market, live in production, and built and operates the full stack: Laravel API (security
fixes, account management, admin panel backend); production and staging servers on a
self-managed VPS, with SSH server configuration, database administration and deploy/rollback
scripts; a React admin panel with role-based permissions and the public landing page; and
the Flutter mobile app (GetX, Clean Architecture, CI/CD-gated releases).
Stack: Laravel, React, Flutter, Dart, GetX, Clean Architecture, REST API, VPS (staging and
production), CI/CD.

### EduPal
https://edu-pal.tech/
Sole Full-Stack Engineer. Adopted by Al Sham Private University as the operational system
for its student housing department, serving 100+ students plus housing staff and managers.
Mobile app, web dashboard and backend delivered single-handedly. Digitizes room assignments,
contracts, deposits, room inventory and payment tracking, with a dual-wallet finance system
and a real-time ledger.
Stack: Flutter, GetX, Clean Architecture, PostgreSQL, JWT, VPS (Nginx).

### Foundation for the Support & Protection of Citizens Abroad
https://syru-legal.up.railway.app/ar
Backend Developer & Maintainer. Public platform of a non-profit legal advisory foundation
serving Russian nationals in Syria. Bilingual Arabic/Russian interface with full RTL and
Cyrillic support, and a consultation request workflow routed to the legal team. Bot and
abuse protection via Cloudflare Turnstile, honeypot fields and strict security headers.
Built in one month, maintained in production since, ~500 monthly visitors.
Stack: Laravel 11, Cloudflare Turnstile, Brevo API, hosted on Railway.

### OboSyria
https://obosyria.com/
Sole Engineer. Moderated classifieds platform for real estate and vehicle listings, where
every listing is reviewed and approved before publication. Laravel REST API serving a React
single-page application from the same origin, delivered as an installable PWA with a service
worker. Passwordless WhatsApp OTP login, administrator MFA, and rate limiting at both the
application and Nginx layers. Deployed and operating in pre-launch. Not yet publicly launched.
Stack: Laravel, React (Vite), PWA / Service Workers, Cloudflare R2, WhatsApp OTP (Wasender),
Resend, VPS (Nginx).

### مطمورتي (Matmurti)
https://khaderhash.github.io/matmurti/
Creator & Sole Developer. Free Arabic money tracker for everyday life in Syria (an expense
app in Syrian pounds and US dollars that works without internet). Expenses and income in new
Syrian pounds and dollars, with old-pound input converted automatically (100 old = 1 new),
currency exchanges, and an "All" view in pounds at each day's rate. Fully offline with no
account: data stays on the phone. Excel backup and restore, with the same file moving
between Android and iPhone.
Two ways to get it, both free, from the welcome page https://khaderhash.github.io/matmurti/
(its iPhone and Android buttons; the old address https://www.khaderhash.me/matmurti
redirects there):
- Android: a signed APK (all versions: https://github.com/khaderhash/matmurti/releases).
- iPhone: a web app (PWA) at https://khaderhash.github.io/matmurti/app/. Open it and use
  Share > Add to Home Screen (iOS 16.4 or later); after the first visit it works offline.
  The web app makes no request to any other host.
Same Flutter code for both; on the web, SQLite runs as WebAssembly in the browser.
Backed by 240 automated tests plus browser tests in Chromium and WebKit.
Stack: Flutter, Dart, GetX, SQLite (native and WebAssembly), service worker, Excel (xlsx)
backup, Android, iOS web app.

## Other projects

- **UniVerse.** Graduation project. Smart campus app with a hybrid AI scheduler (n8n +
  Gemini) generating personalised academic schedules from GPA and prerequisite rules, a RAG
  AI chatbot answering student queries in real time, and live bus tracking over WebSockets
  on OpenStreetMap. Flutter, GetX, Clean Architecture, Socket.IO, Firebase FCM.
- **Nibrass Hub.** Personal project. Clean Architecture Flutter build with an assistant
  answering housing and transport questions. Not a production system.
  Flutter, GetX, Clean Architecture, n8n, Gemini, JWT.
- **Expen Scope (EXS).** Personal project. Dual-personality finance assistant for business
  and individual flows, with n8n + Gemini automation.
- **SSSD Mobile App.** Flutter Developer. Mobile service-request and news platform for the
  Syrian Society for Social Development.
- **Smart Telegram Bot / WhatsApp Automation Bot.** Automation Engineer. n8n workflows
  routing Telegram support queries into structured Google Sheets logs; a Node.js WhatsApp
  service handling repeatable customer responses.
